title: Project-reset checkpoint failure text: no "refused" summary for an unresolved Remote error, and no replay promise where none follows
outcome: A project-reset checkpoint failure's text never contradicts itself. A Remote error reply that did not refuse reads as an Engram error with an unknown outcome, not "Engram refused". The "next reset replays the identical checkpoint" clause appears only where a later reset does replay it: not for claim timeouts, where this reset sent nothing, nor for a best-effort disable that keeps no recovery identity. The engram-host-adapter.md bullets match.
acceptance: Project-reset checkpoint failure text: no "refused" summary for an unresolved Remote error, and no replay promise where none follows is done
